description_en: Queries the effective field collection configurations for an HTTP API across each URI of the request in a specified cloud-native API gateway, including the field source, JSONPath, collection status, switch permission, and whether the configuration is derived from a field template
description_zh: 查询指定云原生 API 网关下某个 HTTP API 在各请求路径上已生效的字段采集配置，包括字段来源、JSONPath、是否采集、是否允许切换与是否来自字段模板
kebab_example: aliyun apig get-api-path-field-config --gateway-id gw-123456 --http-api-id api-123456 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetApiPathFieldConfig

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud-native API gateway
parameters.help_zh: 云原生 API 网关 ID
parameters.name: gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the HTTP API
parameters.name: http_api_id

apiId.description_en: The ID of the HTTP API

gatewayId.description_en: The ID of the cloud-native API gateway
gatewayId.description_zh: 云原生 API 网关 ID

pathConfigs.description_en: The list of field configurations grouped by API request path
pathConfigs.description_zh: 按 API 请求路径分组的字段配置列表

additionalProperties.description_en: A set of field configuration items

category.description_en: The statistical category to which the field belongs

fieldKey.description_en: The identity key of the field, which is unique within the same request path, such as input_token
fieldKey.description_zh: 字段的标识键，在同一请求路径内唯一，例如 input_token

fromTemplate.description_en: Indicates whether the field configuration is derived from a field template
fromTemplate.description_zh: 标识该字段配置是否来自字段模板

io.description_en: The message direction to which the field belongs, indicating whether it is extracted from the request or the response
io.description_zh: 字段所属的报文方向，标识取自请求还是响应

jsonPath.description_en: The JSONPath expression of the field in the request or response message, such as usage.prompt_tokens
jsonPath.description_zh: 字段在请求或响应报文中的 JSONPath 表达式，例如 usage.prompt_tokens

jsonPathRewriteAllowed.description_en: Indicates whether the JSONPath of the field can be rewritten
jsonPathRewriteAllowed.description_zh: 标识该字段的 JSONPath 是否允许改写

name.description_en: The display name of the field

recordEnabled.description_en: Indicates whether collection is enabled for the field
recordEnabled.description_zh: 标识该字段的采集是否已开启

rule.description_en: The value extraction rule for the field

sensitive.description_en: Indicates whether the field contains sensitive information
sensitive.description_zh: 标识该字段是否属于敏感信息

source.description_en: The source of the field value, indicating which part of the message the field is read from, such as response_body
source.description_zh: 字段取值来源，标识该字段从报文的哪一部分读取，例如 response_body

toggleAllowed.description_en: Indicates whether the collection status of the field can be toggled
toggleAllowed.description_zh: 标识该字段的采集开关是否允许切换

fieldPaths.description_en: The collection of field configurations under the path, grouped by mapping key, where each group represents a set of field configuration items
fieldPaths.description_zh: 该路径下的字段配置集合，按映射键分组，每组为一组字段配置项

path.description_en: The request path of the API
